messages:
Harper Lee: Quick FYI  Aurora Labs wants to run a POC with their tuned `opt-6.7b-aurora` variant. Primary asks: can we serve their HF weights + LoRA, recommend quant/variant for latency, and a Dedicated ballpark? They mentioned strict data residency.
Nikhil Rao: Do they provide full checkpoint or adapter? Also need expected avg tokens/convo and peak QPS. That drives node sizing.
Harper Lee: They said full checkpoint + 12MB LoRA on top of our base. Repo is private HF, will share after DPA. Data residency: US-only.
Elena Soto: Runtime quick take: opt-6.7b usually fine with nf4 on H100. For US-only region, prefer dedicated H100 nodes in us-west-2. For p95 <140ms on short chats (~80 tokens) suggest 2x H100 reserved for pilot.
Nikhil Rao: Suggested variant configs: `opt-6.7b-aurora-nf4` on H100, and fallback `opt-6.7b-aurora-8bit` for A100. Need to run tokenization check first.
Elena Soto: Test commands for SEs:
```
python tools/tokenizer_check.py --repo auroralabs/opt-6.7b-aurora
python tools/verify_adapter.py --repo auroralabs/opt-6.7b-aurora
python tools/convert_to_nf4.py --in /tmp/adapter.pt --out /tmp/adapter_nf4.pt
```
Harper Lee: Pricing ask: can you give a ballpark for SOW? If pilot only (private hosted H100) vs Dedicated reserved.
Nikhil Rao: Ballpark: hosted private pilot (H100 on-demand) ~ $7k/mo. Dedicated baseline for p95 <140ms at modest scale: 2xH100 reserved ~ $20k/mo. Add ~12% for HA and burst, +20% if they insist on A100-only.
Grant Morales: Ops note: for residency + PHI-like controls we prefer Dedicated or Private with customer-managed KMS and contract clause. I'll prep the DPA + residency checklist.
Harper Lee: Action items: (1) I'll collect HF link, sample prompts, and QPS from buyer (2) Elena to run tokenizer + nf4 convert smoke (3) Nikhil to draft pricing note for SOW (4) Grant to send DPA/residency checklist. ETA EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: ticket #INF-8548 created: "Aurora Labs  opt-6.7b-aurora onboarding + nf4 smoke" assigned to Elena, Nikhil, Grant.
Harper Lee: thanks all ":rocket:"
